gripOrHq.title: Audit of Call Records
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if Runner attempted two or more runs during last turn. Trace 5 - If successful, give Runner 1 tag.

gripOrHq.title: Chance Observation
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if Runner attempted a run during last turn. Trace 5 - If successful, give Runner 1 tag.

gripOrHq.title: Shock.r
gripOrHq.rulesText: [Subroutine] Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during the run, and cannot jack out until after that encounter.

gripOrHq.title: Punitive Counterstrike
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Do 2 meat damage.

ice.title: Hunter
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.
